findings.statement: Scope: one bounded replay (run run:72cf0e4b91a3, 55 dataset events, 3 of 3 jobs completed, clink exit status 0, not cancelled; fan-in threshold 5 distinct senders in a 3,600,000 ms window; onward links within 1,800,000 ms). The graph holds 55 transfers, 48 accounts, 35 devices, 14 onward links and 2 fan-in alerts. Everything below holds only for this dataset as this run processed it.

Alert fan_in:A-9278:1794301200000: account A-9278, window 1794301200000 to 1794304800000, 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 357000 minor units. Contributing transfers: T0002, T0003, T0006, T0010, T0011, T0012 (from A-4452, A-4366, A-7266, A-8133, A-6801, A-3881, each on a different device, amounts from 38000 to 89000).

Alert fan_in:A-9895:1794319200000: account A-9895, window 1794319200000 to 1794322800000, 6 distinct senders, 6 transfers, total 15000 minor units. Contributing transfers: T0035, T0036, T0037, T0038, T0039, T0040, each exactly 2500, from A-8770, A-4399, A-4792, A-9088, A-8060, A-8166, each on a different device.

Onward links for A-9278: all six contributing transfers are passed on. T0002, T0003 and T0006 link to T0007 (A-9278 to A-5092, 138000), then T0008 (A-5092 to A-2897, 135000), then T0009 (A-2897 to A-4989, 132000). T0010, T0011 and T0012 link to T0014 (A-9278 to A-5092, 210000), then T0015 (A-5092 to A-2897, 206000), then T0016 (A-2897 to A-4989, 202000). The longest chain has 3 onward links. T0009 and T0016 are not passed on, so both chains end at A-4989. The route accounts are A-9278, A-5092, A-2897 and A-4989.

Onward links for A-9895: only T0038, T0039 and T0040 are passed on. All three link to T0041 (A-9895 to A-1415, 14000), and T0041 is not passed on. The longest chain has 1 onward link, and the money comes to rest at A-1415. T0035, T0036 and T0037 are not passed on, so they start no chain. The route accounts are A-9895 and A-1415.

Shared devices on the A-9278 routes: A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897 each sent from device D-568. All six onward transfers T0007, T0008, T0009, T0014, T0015 and T0016 were sent from D-568. The resting account A-4989 sent no transfers in the dataset.

Shared devices on the A-9895 route: none. No device was used to send by two or more of its route accounts. A-9895 sent T0041 from D-699. A-1415 sent T0055 (to A-9514, 90000, at 1794333900000) from D-785. T0055 is not an onward link of T0041: it came 11,700,000 ms later, beyond the 1,800,000 ms onward gap.

The only other device in the dataset used by two or more sending accounts is D-619, used by A-2952 (T0027) and A-9652 (T0019), both paying A-5093. It is not on either alert's routes. Note that A-5093 is a different account from route account A-5092.

What distinguishes the two alerts, which look alike as indicators (6 senders and 6 transfers each, within one hour): (a) totals of 357000 against 15000, with uniform 2500 credits for A-9895; (b) all six A-9278 credits are passed on through chains 3 links deep, against three of six A-9895 credits passed on 1 link deep; (c) the A-9278 onward route, three distinct accounts, was sent entirely from one device, D-568, while the A-9895 route shares no device. None of the downstream accounts A-5092, A-2897, A-4989 or A-1415 has its own fan-in alert. The A-9278 alert therefore comes with a recorded multi-hop, single-device onward structure. The A-9895 alert is a fan-in with a short, partial onward link and no device overlap.

Traceable provenance: every statement above comes from transfers, onward links and indicators in this graph, identified by their dataset ids, under the run record's parameters and the dataset sha256 72cf0e4b91a3...

hypotheses.statement: Because one device, D-568, sent every hop from A-9278 through A-5092 and A-2897 to A-4989, with small amount reductions at each hop (138000 to 135000 to 132000; 210000 to 206000 to 202000), these accounts may be controlled by one party moving collected funds in layers. The data records only device use and transfers; it does not establish common control, ownership or fraud.

The A-9895 alert, with uniform 2500 credits and only part of them passed on in a single hop, may be benign collection activity (for example, a shared bill or a group payment) rather than mule activity. That is an interpretation; the data does not establish the purpose.
A-9278 forwarded 348000 of the 357000 it received. The 3000 to 4000 shortfall at each later hop could be fees or retained amounts. That is not recorded.

unresolved.question: What happens to the funds at A-4989 after T0009 and T0016? A-4989 sends nothing in this bounded dataset, and later activity, if there is any, lies outside it.

Is A-1415's later transfer T0055 (90000 to A-9514, from D-585... D-785) related to the 14000 it received in T0041? It falls outside the onward gap and its amount exceeds the credit, so the data does not link them.
Who uses device D-568, and does using one device mean one person or entity across A-9278, A-5092 and A-2897? The data cannot say.
Is there any relationship between D-619's users (A-2952, A-9652) paying A-5093 and route account A-5092, beyond the similar ids? Nothing recorded connects them.
